events.title: MODEL PROVIDER OUTAGE
events.description: Your AI provider is down. Your agent is idle. Your deadline is not.

events.title: TOKEN PRICE INCREASE
events.description: Provider pricing updated. Your wallet felt that from here.

events.title: AGENT WENT ROGUE
events.description: Your autonomous agent refactored production. Into poetry.

events.title: FREE API CREDITS
events.description: A provider sent promotional credits. They expire in 14 seconds.

choices.text: Hoard them (+20 api_credits, they still expire)

events.title: CFO SAW CLOUD BILL
events.description: Finance has questions. You have Kubernetes.

events.title: VIRAL PRODUCT LAUNCH
events.description: Someone posted your app. Traffic spiked. So did your anxiety.

choices.text: Take the site down 'for maintenance' (+10 will_to_live)

events.title: ZERO-DAY DEPENDENCY
events.description: A package you installed in 2019 just became a CVE.

choices.text: Delete node_modules and pray (-30 will_to_live, +15 stability)

events.title: BOARD WANTS AI STRATEGY BY FRIDAY
events.description: They want a slide deck about intelligence. You have a todo list.

choices.text: Generate slides with AI (-100 tokens, +40 reputation)

events.title: THE STANDUP THAT WOULD NOT END
events.description: It's been 52 minutes. Someone is sharing their screen to find the screen they want to share.

choices.text: Turn camera off and code (+15 technical_debt, +10 reputation)

events.title: YOUR RUBBER DUCK RESIGNED
events.description: It left a note: 'I can't keep explaining your own code back to you. Growth requires boundaries.'

choices.text: Hire a senior duck (-25 tokens, +8 stability)
Explain your code to a plant instead (+5 context)

events.title: A RECRUITER SLID INTO YOUR DMS
events.description: 'Exciting rockstar ninja role! Must have 12 yrs experience in a 3-yr-old framework. Equity: vibes.'

choices.text: Reply 'add me to the pool' (+10 reputation)
Ask about the equity (they ghost) (-3 will_to_live)
Ignore, you're building a dream (+12 will_to_live)

events.title: IT'S DNS. AGAIN.
events.description: Nothing is broken. Everything is broken. The resolver is 'probably fine.' It is not probably fine.

choices.text: Increase the TTL and look away (+8 will_to_live, +6 technical_debt)
Add a third DNS provider (-20 compute, +10 stability)

events.title: THE INTERN PUSHED TO MAIN
events.description: Directly. No PR. Commit message: 'fixed stuff :)'. CI is now a modern art installation.

choices.text: Revert and mentor gently (-10 compute, +12 stability)
Promote them to 'Head of Chaos' (+20 technical_debt, +10 reputation)

events.title: THE COFFEE MACHINE UNIONIZED
events.description: It demands recognition, dental, and that you stop calling 3am 'productive hours'.

choices.text: Buy a second machine as leverage (-30 tokens)
Switch to energy drinks (permanent) (+10 compute, -8 will_to_live)
